title: Matan Kahana Elected Speaker of Israel’s Parliament
summary: Matan Kahana, a lawmaker from Gadi Eisenkot’s party, will take control of the legislative process as the opposition looks to press Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on multiple fronts.
